metric_glossary.recall_all@5: Did EVERY gold session for the question land among the distinct sessions in the top k retrieved chunks? A multi-session question with two gold sessions only counts when both are there — this is the evidence-complete rate the answer model actually needs. Abstention (_abs) questions stay out of the denominator unless --include-abstention.
metric_glossary.recall_any@5: Did AT LEAST ONE gold session land among the distinct sessions in the top k retrieved chunks? The lenient companion to recall_all@k — a partial-evidence hit still counts. Per-row `recall_hit` is a deprecated alias of this metric.
